snippet.title: PixelJunk Eden 2 Launch Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
■PixelJunk™ Eden 2 is available on the Nintendo Switch eShop page
A special 34% discount will be available until December 16th, 2020 to celebrate the game’s launch!
US: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/pixeljunk-eden-2-switch/
UK:https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/PixelJunk-Eden-2-1742913.html

■Jump, Spin, Swing, Travel Through Beautiful Organic Worlds
PixelJunk™ Eden 2 is a meditative experience from acclaimed Japanese multimedia artist Baiyon. Baiyon returns once again to the PixelJunk™ Eden series to provide his unique vision of art and music in order to create an unforgettable experience that draws players in.

Players travel through the luscious Gardens, full of unique plants and vegetation with the help of Grimps. By filling up the Seeds with Pollen, players can open new Plants and pathways as they journey through their colorful, organic world. Grimps have the ability to jump and swing, providing a lively take on the action platformer genre. When the Grimps move, players can feel their presence in the Gardens as their world changes in appearance, shape and form. Players will create unique paintings in real time as they explore the Gardens. In addition, players can choose their favorite levels and explore how they want in the unlockable Garden Collection mode. Combine variants of Spices, Grimps, and Gardens for a rich and challenging experience. There are so many Grimps, and Spices each with their own unique ability and enhancements to discover. Combine these to navigate through the Gardens and recover the Spectra, which serves as the source of life in the world of Eden.    

■「PixelJunk™ Eden 2」Basic Information:
Title：PixelJunk™ Eden 2
Developer：Q-Games
Release Date：December 10th, 2020
Genre：Action, Multiplayer, Music
Number of Players： up to 2 players
Platform：Nintendo Switch™
For all ages.

PixelJunk™ Eden 2 will be released soon! You can get the game 34% cheaper if you purchase the game before December 16th, 2020. The standard price of the game will be $14.99/€ 12,99. The price during special sale: $9.89 / € 8,57.

PixelJunk™ Eden 2  has English, Japanese, French, German, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean language support.
